flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the Senate moved up by a moderate amount, and Democrats remain the favoured party. The Democrats Adam Hamilton in [[Kansas]] and Troy Jackson in [[Maine]] both gained ground, and the market sees each of those seats as a predicted flip. In [[Montana]], the Republican Kurt Alme also strengthened somewhat.
summaries.governor: In [[Nevada]], the Democrat Aaron Ford saw a sizable drop in their chances in the Polymarket odds, and the market still sees the seat as a predicted flip. In [[Georgia]], the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms gained moderate ground, and that race is also a predicted flip. The Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins in [[Alaska]] slipped slightly, in another race the market sees as a predicted flip.
summaries.house: The projected House count has shifted slightly, now 239-196 in the Democrats' favor, down from 240-195, and it still shows Democrats gaining control. One district, South Carolina's Mount Pleasant and Summerville seat, is no longer a predicted flip. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott made a sharp gain in the Polymarket odds against the Democrat Paul Barringer.
